articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and real-world agentic coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and junior software engineers on end-to-end project completion.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Discovery Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with a focus on autonomous scientific research workflows, including hypothesis generation, experiment design, and literature synthesis. Internal evaluations show the model can independently reproduce findings from recent Nature papers when given access to relevant datasets and compute APIs, raising questions about the future role of AI co-scientists.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Real-Time Tool Use and Persistent Memory for Enterprise Agents
articles.summary: Anthropic rolled out persistent memory and real-time tool orchestration capabilities for Claude, enabling enterprise deployments where the model retains structured context across sessions and autonomously chains API calls. Early adopters in financial services report 40% reductions in analyst workflow times for compliance and due diligence tasks.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started performing real production tasks at two of its U.S. factories, including parts handling, quality inspection, and bin picking. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-degree-of-freedom hands and on-device vision-language models for task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction and Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched its commercial Atlas platform powered by electric actuation and integrated LLM-based task planning, targeting construction site automation and warehouse logistics. The system can interpret natural language work orders, plan multi-step physical tasks, and coordinate with fleets of mobile robots, marking a significant step toward general-purpose commercial humanoids.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and NVIDIA, pushing its valuation past $15 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated manufacturing facility in Texas and expand deployment of its Figure 03 humanoid, which integrates OpenAI-powered conversational reasoning for warehouse and light industrial tasks.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node has entered volume production at its Fab 22 in Taiwan, approximately one quarter ahead of the original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerators from NVIDIA and Apple shipping in early 2027.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Phase II Takes Effect, Mandating Risk Assessments for Foundation Models
articles.summary: The second enforcement phase of the EU AI Act went into effect, requiring providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk classifications to submit detailed safety evaluations, red-team reports, and energy consumption disclosures. Major labs including OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic have published their first compliance reports, setting a de facto global transparency standard that is influencing upcoming U.S. and UK regulatory proposals.
